feed.title: Feed
feed.description: Posts, polls and questions from the community.
feed.empty: No posts yet — write the first one!
feed.guestText: Sign in to post, vote and join the conversation.

placeholder.post: What would you like to share?
placeholder.poll: What should the community vote on?
placeholder.question: What would you like to ask the community?

composer.scheduledHint: It goes into the feed automatically at the time you picked — until then only you see it, under “Scheduled posts”.
composer.failedHint: Your text is still in the field. Check your connection and try again.

poll.voteFailedHint: Your vote never arrived. Click your option again.

card.editFailedHint: Your text is still in the field. Try again; if it keeps failing, reload the page.
card.deleteFailedHint: The post is still there. Reload the page and try again.
card.reportedHint: Moderation will take a look. There is no individual reply to single reports.
card.reportFailedHint: The report never arrived. Try again — if it keeps failing, contact moderation directly.
card.voteFailedHint: Your vote never arrived. Click again.

moderation.title: Feed posts
moderation.hiddenHint: The community can no longer see it, and the open reports about it are settled. “Restore” undoes both.
moderation.actionFailedHint: Nothing about the post changed. Reload the page and try again.

assist.failedHint: The AI access may not be set up, or the service is unreachable right now. The assessment is only a hint — the decision is yours either way.

mine.title: My posts
mine.confirmDeleteText: The post disappears from the feed. This cannot be undone.
mine.deletedHint: It is gone from the feed — its comments are no longer reachable either.
mine.deleteFailedHint: The post is still there. Reload the page and try again.
mine.empty: Your own posts collect here — writing happens in the feed.

validation.pollEndFuture: The poll end must be in the future.
validation.scheduleFuture: The date must be in the future.
validation.scheduleTooFar: The date is too far in the future (max. 90 days).

milestone.posts: 🎉 Community post number {count} was just published!
